title: Amlici seeks kingship
summary: At the commencement of the fifth year of their reign, contention begins among the people. Amlici draws many people after him, and they begin to seek to establish him as king.

explicit_facts.text: Contention begins among the people at the commencement of the fifth year of their reign.
Amlici draws many people after him by his cunning.
They begin to endeavor to establish Amlici as king over the people.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A group of people near Amlici could visually suggest his growing support.
unspecified_visual_details: Amlici's appearance and clothing
The specific location

narration.text: there began to be a contention among the people

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Amlici is described as cunning and wise according to the wisdom of the world. The reference to the man who slew Gideon concerns an earlier event, not an action in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Gideon's killing or the execution mentioned in Alma 2:1 as occurring in this scene.
Do not invent speeches or a coronation.

title: Concern over the law
summary: Church members and others not persuaded by Amlici are alarmed that he might gain the people's voice and deprive them of their rights and church privileges.

explicit_facts.text: The people of the church and those not drawn away by Amlici are alarmed.
They understand that their law requires such matters to be established by the voice of the people.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Concerned people may be shown discussing the threat.
unspecified_visual_details: The particular people shown, their appearance, and the place of their discussion.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The stated intent and feared consequences are reported by the narrative, not spoken dialogue.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show Amlici carrying out these feared consequences.

title: The people assemble to decide
summary: Throughout the land, people assemble in separate bodies according to whether they support or oppose Amlici. They dispute, assemble to cast their voices, and their voices are laid before the judges.

explicit_facts.text: People assemble throughout the land in separate bodies, for or against Amlici, and dispute with one another.

unspecified_visual_details: The voting procedure, architecture, and appearance of the judges and people.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a specific ballot method or invent speeches.

title: The people's voice rejects Amlici
summary: The voice of the people comes against Amlici, and he is not made king. Those against him rejoice, while Amlici stirs those in his favor to anger against them.

explicit_facts.text: The voice of the people came against Amlici, and he was not made king.

Amlici stirred those in his favor to anger against those who were not in his favor.

Those in his favor may visibly show anger.
unspecified_visual_details: The location, how the people's decision is conveyed, and the people's precise appearances and gestures.

narration.text: And it came to pass that the voice of the people came against Amlici, that he was not made king over the people.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Amlici being crowned king.

title: The groups prepare for war
summary: Amlici's people are called Amlicites, and the remainder are called Nephites. The Nephites arm themselves and appoint captains. Amlici arms his people and appoints rulers and leaders to lead them to war.

title: Battle at hill Amnihu
summary: The Amlicites come to hill Amnihu, east of the river Sidon, and begin war with the Nephites. Alma goes against them with his people, captains, and chief captains. Nephites slay Amlicites on the hill; the Amlicites contend strongly, and many Nephites fall.

explicit_facts.text: The Amlicites come upon hill Amnihu, east of the river Sidon, and begin war with the Nephites.

Nephites slay Amlicites on the hill east of Sidon; the Amlicites contend with great strength, and many Nephites fall.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The river Sidon may be visible west of the hill.
unspecified_visual_details: The combatants' appearances, weapons, and the hill's terrain.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict wounds, blood, severed body parts, or other gore.

title: The Amlicites begin to flee

unspecified_visual_details: The battlefield's location and appearance.

they began to flee before them.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The Lord's strengthening is reported, but no visible divine appearance is described.

unspecified_visual_details: The camp’s layout, the tents’ design, and the valley’s appearance.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Gideon’s death is background information, not an event occurring in this scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Gideon or Nehor as present or show Gideon’s death as part of this scene.

summary: On the morrow, the group returns to the Nephite camp in haste and fear. They report seeing a numerous Lamanite host joined by the Amlicites in Minon. They say their brethren are fleeing toward the city with their flocks and families, and warn that the city and their families are in danger if they do not hurry.
